description: Source code for IndexV2DiffStreamProcessor class, which processes JSON streams to handle repository and package diffs in an indexing system.

classes.name: IndexV2DiffStreamProcessor
classes.description: Class responsible for processing JSON streams to apply diffs to an index, utilizing an IndexV2DiffStreamReceiver.

classes.name: IndexStreamSerializer
classes.description: Inner class implementing custom serialization logic for IndexV2 objects during stream processing.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes an input stream of JSON data, applying diffs via the receiver.

methods.description: Deserializes JSON input into IndexV2 objects, applying diffs for 'repo' and 'packages'.

methods.name: diffPackages

methods.name: readMapEntry
